original.prompt: In June 2026, India announced a new suite of Producer Price Indices (PPIs) alongside a revised WPI. Consider the following statements:
items: PPIs are the International Monetary Fund's preferred standard for measuring producer prices.
The PPI suite covers seven service sectors, including banking, telecom and aviation.
The old WPI series will be discontinued as soon as the new series is released.
original.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the old WPI gets a five-year sunset before it is discontinued entirely. The US, EU and Japan had already moved from WPI-style indices to PPIs years ago.
original.source: The old WPI gets a five-year sunset before it's discontinued entirely.

rewritten.prompt: In June 2026, India announced a new suite of Producer Price Indices (PPIs) alongside a revised WPI. Consider the following statements:
items: PPIs are the International Monetary Fund's preferred standard for measuring producer prices.
The PPI suite covers five service sectors, including banking, telecom and aviation.
The old WPI series will be discontinued as soon as the new series is released.
rewritten.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
rewritten.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the PPI suite covers seven service sectors, not five. Statement 3 is wrong because the old WPI gets a five-year sunset before it is discontinued entirely. The US, EU and Japan had already moved from WPI-style indices to PPIs years ago.
rewritten.source: alongside a new suite of Producer Price Indices (PPIs) covering outputs, inputs, and seven service sectors including banking, telecom, and aviation.
